fields.q: 静下心来，让它成为幽静的池水，把自己交给寂静。冥想是好事。
fields.en: Still your mind. Let it be a secluded pond. Give yourself to silence. It is good to meditate.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 静下心来，让它成为幽静的池水，把自己交给寂静。冥想是好事。

en.value: Still your mind. Let it be a secluded pond. Give yourself to silence. It is good to meditate.

fields.q: 我从你身上感到某种深邃而危险的东西。也许安萨拉能把它揭露出来。
fields.en: I sense in you something profound and menacing. Perhaps Answerer can expose it.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 我从你身上感到某种深邃而危险的东西。也许安萨拉能把它揭露出来。

en.value: I sense in you something profound and menacing. Perhaps Answerer can expose it.

fields.q: 我斩杀过巨鸟。但我觉得和你交手会更有乐趣。
fields.en: I have slain giant birds. Yet I feel I would enjoy battling you even more.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 我斩杀过巨鸟。但我觉得和你交手会更有乐趣。

en.value: I have slain giant birds. Yet I feel I would enjoy battling you even more.

fields.q: 你毫无惧色。这很少见。你很少见。
fields.en: You show no signs of fear. That is unusual. You are unusual.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 你毫无惧色。这很少见。你很少见。

en.value: You show no signs of fear. That is unusual. You are unusual.

fields.q: 找不到值得一决的对手。我很渴——不是喉咙，是灵魂。
fields.en: I cannot find a fitting opponent for a duel. I am parched. Not my throat, but my soul.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 找不到值得一决的对手。我很渴——不是喉咙，是灵魂。

en.value: I cannot find a fitting opponent for a duel. I am parched. Not my throat, but my soul.

fields.q: 一头海兽让我漂流到了这片土地。或许这就是命运之手。
fields.en: A sea beast diverted me to this land. Perhaps it was the hand of fate.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 一头海兽让我漂流到了这片土地。或许这就是命运之手。

en.value: A sea beast diverted me to this land. Perhaps it was the hand of fate.

fields.q: 我讨厌束缚我的人……他们扼杀快乐，只带来无聊。
fields.en: I dislike those who fetter me… They constrain joy and supply boredom.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 我讨厌束缚我的人……他们扼杀快乐，只带来无聊。

en.value: I dislike those who fetter me… They constrain joy and supply boredom.

fields.q: 我喜欢你的眼睛，像阳光一样明亮。
fields.en: I like your eyes. They are as bright as sunlight.
fields.name: 迪托利希

q.value: 我喜欢你的眼睛，像阳光一样明亮。
